purpose: Diagnose executable tutorial timeout without raising the cell budget or reducing workload

baseline.result: stopped after computation cell exceeded its300-second notebook budget
baseline.resource_contention: other focused test processes running; full matrix stopped during the probe

conclusion: Repeated lowering of the SPD projection derivative was a major cost. Reusing a compiled projection let the unchanged tutorial workload finish within the existing cell budget.
limitations: Wall times were measured with other task processes running, so this is a diagnosis rather than a controlled performance benchmark.
